why_not_confirmatory: Input artifact SHA-256 fields were null in preregistration; the frozen protocol specified input-manifest hash before primary run, which was not achieved. Deterministic artifact hashes listed in provenance were calculated after first score.
Frozen Python 3.12 and dual-platform qualification were not executed: local run was Python 3.13.5 Linux.
Synthetic donor matrices were generated from known hand-authored rule family, not an independently pretrained donor.
No independently controlled unfamiliar real-task evaluation, matched fully trained baseline, or accepted Yggdrasil native integration.
interpretation: Exactly decodes a restrictive 2/3-literal gate family from synthetic weight tensors to a compact binary motif circuit. Does not establish the capacity to decode generic pretrained model weights, know causal semantics, preserve neural function beyond declared binary domain, beat the exact symbolic control, or enhance Yggdrasil intelligence. Full serialization comparison includes 8-byte floats and is not a fair optimized compression comparison.
